text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I passed by the outdoor stage—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ! P-Pleeaaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To summarize, Falco-san wishes for our
assistance in producing a new song.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The theme of the new track is "Megane Girl in Love."
Apparently, that is why Ikuno-kun, Rob Roy-kun,
and I were singled out.
choice_data_list: So that's why you're wearing glasses.
So that's why you had glasses on.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! You gotta look the part
first to get into character☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...So, the song is mostly done for now, but
it feels like it's still missing something~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna make it, I want a song that really
shows off the charm of glasses girls! So please!
Pleeease pleeease pretty pleaaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We don't mind helping out, but
what exactly are we supposed to do?
choice_data_list: What is the charm of a glasses girl in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In typical stories, they are often portrayed as
intellectual, earnest, and composed characters, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but that's just a stereotype! I want
more realistic, relatable feelings of actual
glasses girls in there!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And while we're at it, some cuteness, maturity,
and that bittersweet feeling of love~...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
May I make a suggestion?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If all of us rack our brains simultaneously, solving
this will take considerable time.
Shall we divide our roles instead?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san on narrative and poetry,
Hayahide-san on drafting a plan tailored to the goal,
and Falco-san on establishing the song's overall image.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And I shall oversee management. By specializing in
our respective areas of expertise, we should be able
to achieve peak performance.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san, I would like you to create the lyrical base
drawing inspiration from various stories and your own
personal experiences with wearing glasses.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see... Approaching it that way,
I feel like I can actually contribute...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As for choreography, Falco-san is best suited.
I will demonstrate various behavioral patterns involving glasses,
so please infuse them with your Umadol charm.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Time to make a super cute
megane girl dance routine~☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Which means I should design staging that maximizes
the impact of both the song and the dance, correct?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. With your planning, Hayahide-san,
we will surely elevate the performance's
overall quality to the next level.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! Thanks to everyone,
the ultimate new song is complete☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
I am glad to have been of service.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
I am glad to have been of service.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was truly magnificent...!
You acted just like a real manager!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both Rob Roy-kun and I tend to lose track of time
when we get passionate... Having Ikuno-kun manage
the schedule was a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I am honored by your praise.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, we have exerted our minds beyond
initial estimates, so let us take a proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Demonstrating the competence of an ideal boss,
Ikuno Dictus left everyone thoroughly impressed once more.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, a song can only be considered truly complete
once performed. Let us begin live practice at once!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thus, under the guidance of top-tier manager
Ikuno Dictus, their practice session commenced.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: L-La, la la la~♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on...
Why are Rob Roy-kun and I singing too...?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! I can totally feel the Umadol
aura radiating from everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards—caught up in the momentum, they formed
a unit named "Glasses×Grasses" and held a live show.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the resounding success, Ikuno Dictus's
glasses were said to sparkle even brighter than usual.
